policies.title: Peruvian ordinary passports: Grenada visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Grenada's currently linked official nationality schedule lists Peru as requiring no visitor visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Peruvian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The active Embassy schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service, special-document and final-admission treatment remain outside scope.

policies.title: Peruvian ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule expressly includes Peru in the no-visa visitor cohort for stays up to three months.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Peruvian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The named no-visa cohort states a maximum tourist stay of three months.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Peruvian ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's live Tourism Board nationality table states that Peruvian visitors can obtain a 40-JOD visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Peruvian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The Tourism Board table says all non-Jordanians must register for a Gateway2Jordan QR code before departure.
Entry-point, admission and non-visitor categories remain governed by Jordanian authorities.

policies.title: Peruvian ordinary passports: Iceland visa-free short stays
policies.summary: Iceland's current visa regulation expressly lists Peru among nationalities exempt from an entry visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Peruvian passport for short Schengen visits of up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
Work, residence, transit-specific rules, special documents and final border admission remain outside scope.
